messages:
Maia Brooks: Quick pass on a compact catalog iteration — goal: denser rows for power users and clearer pin semantics. Mock: https://figma.com/file/new-compact
Priya Nair: Looks promising. Contrast check: perf badge purple (#8F6CFF) might fail in light. Please run WCAG and propose alt hex.
Alex Rivera: Condensing hides p50 and cost. Suggest primary badge = p95, then on hover show a small card with p50, tokens/request, GPU-cost score.
Maia Brooks: Also thinking 'Skip to compare' link at top for keyboard users, and a small toast when pinning: "Pinned {model} v{n}. Undo" with 5s timeout.
Jon Chen: Keyboard: row focus order should be name -> metrics -> pin -> overflow. Enter/Space toggle expansion; global shortcut ? for shortcuts modal, and 'P' for quick-pin when a row is focused.
Samir Patel: Microcopy: use 'Pin version for compare' as tooltip text. State label should read 'Pinned: v2' vs action 'Pin'.
Priya Nair: ARIA: pin button needs aria-label="Toggle pin for {model} {version}", aria-pressed, and a polite aria-live announcement: "{model} v{n} pinned for compare".
Alex Rivera: Can we add a small status indicator on compare toolbar showing count of pinned variants? e.g., 'Compare (3 pinned)'.
DesignBot: Accessibility check: #8F6CFF contrast 3.5:1 on 12px; fails AA. Recommend #6F4BFF or white text + 1px outline. Created ticket UI-4010.
Maia Brooks: Action items: Priya pick colors + ARIA labels, Alex draft hover card content, Jon write experiment spec and shortcuts doc, Samir finalize microcopy. I'll open tickets and attach prototype.
Priya Nair: LGTM :+1:
Jon Chen: I'll also add metric: time-to-pin and keyboard activation rate for the A/B.
Samir Patel: Nice. Small follow-up: ensure focus ring spans full row when using arrow keys to navigate.
Maia Brooks: Thanks team — I'll post updated mocks and ticket links by EOD.
